concepts.label: Extended Attributes (XATTR) - application-specific document metadata
concepts.reused_or_minted: reused - this id was minted in round 4 (extractions/java-sdk/howtos/distributed-acid-transactions-from-the-sdk.json) purely as a PLACEHOLDER for this exact page, which round 4 never read directly ('placeholder for the linked concept-docs/xattr.md page'). This record supplies the real, first-hand content behind that stub: 'Couchbase Server permits the addition of _extended attributes_ (XATTRs). These allow developers to define application-specific metadata that will only be visible to those applications that request it or attempt to modify it.' The id is unchanged; only its evidentiary basis is upgraded from a forward-reference to an actual reading of the page.

concepts.label: Virtual Extended Attributes ($document macro exposing storage-level metadata)
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - a distinct, on-demand-generated subset of XATTRs (not stored, computed from document metadata like expiry), given its own subsection and code example on the page.

concepts.label: Sub-document operations (lookupIn/mutateIn)
concepts.reused_or_minted: reused - the page states XATTR support is implemented as 'extensions to the _Sub-Document API_', with an `xattr` flag on a subdocument operation.

relations.subject: sdk:xattr
relations.evidence: The SDK supports extended attributes by means of extensions to the _Sub-Document API_: so that extended attributes can be defined, searched for, edited, removed, and more.

relations.subject: sdk:virtual-xattr
relations.evidence: _Virtual_ extended attributes consist of metadata on an individual document: this can be retrieved by specifying `$document` as a search-path

notable_absence.finding: The page states 'The maximum content size for a document stored in Couchbase Server is 20MB. XATTRs — including Virtual XATTRs — will reduce the space available for the remainder of the document', a real trade-off fact, but no promoted predicate cleanly captures 'consumes space from a shared document-size budget' without overstating a configuration relationship (tradesOffAgainst is reserved in the registry for vector-index strategy comparisons specifically). Left as a finding rather than forced into a relation.

cross_component_finding: Directly resolves the round's flagged question about sdk:xattr: this page is the real, first-hand source for a concept that had existed in the extraction layer since round 4 purely as a placeholder minted from a forward link on a different page (distributed-acid-transactions-from-the-sdk.md). The id and registry_status (extraction-layer, not yet promoted) are unchanged - no new id was minted for the core XATTR concept - but this record is the first to actually read and describe it. Also notable: this page is markedly thinner than the howto it points to (`../howtos/subdocument-operations.md`) and thinner still than the server-side extended-attributes-fundamentals.md it defers to twice; its own content adds nothing beyond the Virtual XATTR distinction that those two pages don't already cover in more depth.
